newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Boral shareholders okay pref shares.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Boral shareholders okay pref shares.

text.p: Shareholders in building products and energy group Boral Ltd voted to approve a change in the company's articles of association, allowing Boral the authority to issue converting preference shares if needed.
Boral's annual meeting was adjourned for two hours after Boral's chairman Peter Cottrell called a poll when a motion to amend the articles was defeated by a show of hands.
Boral managing director Tony Berg told reporters after the meeting that the company would only issue the converting preference shares if there was a possibility of an acquisition.
"We don't have any presently planned," Berg replied to the question on whether Boral was looking at any acquisitions.
Berg said any issue of converting preference shares could raise about A$100 million and much more if the issue was on a pro-rata basis.
Boral shares closed two cents down to A$3.17.
